reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event on 26 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-26 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-27 00:00:00+00'
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event on 26 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
)
SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
  SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
FROM flagged

WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event on 26 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-26 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-27 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT g.event_id, g.user_id, g.event_ts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gaps s WHERE s.user_id = g.user_id AND s.event_ts <= g.event_ts
     AND (s.prev_ts IS NULL OR s.event_ts - s.prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes')) AS session_no
FROM gaps g

solver.query: WITH f AS (SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM app_events WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-26 00:00:00+00' AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-27 00:00:00+00' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)) SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts, CAST(SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS INTEGER) AS session_no FROM f
